description: Quick fix for an EXTERNAL app repo (internal repos use quick-fix-internal): branch studio/{{slug}} from origin/main → build (local, agent from the Team: line of the intake file) → QA (local) → review (Opus + Codex) → PR labelled owner-review → owner ship gate. Vars: workdir (app checkout), slug, idea (intake file, path relative to workdir).

stages.run: git fetch origin && git switch -c studio/{{slug}} origin/main || (echo branch switch failed - does studio/{{slug}} already exist? delete it or use a new slug && exit 1)

stages.task: Quick fix. Implement exactly what the intake file {{workdir}}/{{idea}} asks for (only that, small and focused), using the Team role named in it; follow its rules. Run the repo's checks before finishing.
stages.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run lint:baseline

stages.task: QA the quick fix {{slug}}: check the change against the acceptance criteria in {{workdir}}/{{idea}}. Follow your 'Pipeline runs' protocol (report file first). Write {{workdir}}/docs/quick-fix/{{slug}}.qa.md ending with a line 'VERDICT: PASS' or 'VERDICT: FAIL'.
stages.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run lint:baseline && node -e "if(!/VERDICT:[\s*_\x60]*PASS/.test(require('fs').readFileSync('{{workdir}}/docs/quick-fix/{{slug}}.qa.md','utf8')))process.exit(1)"

stages.task: Review the whole diff of branch studio/{{slug}} against origin/main in {{workdir}} for the fix described in {{workdir}}/{{idea}}. Write {{workdir}}/docs/quick-fix/{{slug}}.review.md ending with 'APPROVE' or 'REQUEST CHANGES'.

Review the whole diff of branch studio/{{slug}} against origin/main in {{workdir}} for the fix described in {{workdir}}/{{idea}}. Write {{workdir}}/docs/quick-fix/{{slug}}.review-codex.md ending with 'APPROVE' or 'REQUEST CHANGES'.

stages.run: git add -A -- . ":(exclude)docs/intake" && git commit -m "fix: {{slug}}" && git push -u origin studio/{{slug}} && gh pr create --base main --label owner-review --fill

stages.title: {{slug}}: PR opened (label owner-review). Owner: review and merge the PR, then publish.
